n75de75244a.headline: EU seeks G7 coordination on maritime services ban on Russian seaborne oil
n75de75244a.summary: The EU is seeking G7 coordination on a maritime services ban on Russian seaborne oil. A full ban would end exports of Russian oil carried by Western tankers.
n75de75244a.why: Russia is a major crude oil exporter, and Western shipping and insurance services underpin much of its seaborne trade. Restrictions here can tighten available supply and affect global oil prices.

n81c86049ca.headline: Qantas shares nosedive amid weak international demand
n81c86049ca.summary: Qantas shares rose in early trading before falling to a three-month low amid weak international demand, according to the report.
n81c86049ca.why: Qantas is Australia's largest airline, and its share price reflects demand for long-haul and international travel.
n81c86049ca.why_moved: The report cites weak international demand as the backdrop to the share decline.

nda2454b285.headline: Kenya Raises $2.25b in Eurobond Sale to Fund Debt Buyback
nda2454b285.summary: Kenya raised $2.25 billion from international markets through a dual-tranche Eurobond. Proceeds will finance a $500 million debt buyback and support the budget.
nda2454b285.why: Eurobonds are dollar-denominated sovereign bonds sold to international investors, and their pricing signals a country's external borrowing conditions.

n42ea605cc7.headline: AFRICA-FX-Uganda's currency expected to fall, most others seen steady
n42ea605cc7.summary: Uganda's currency is expected to weaken against the dollar in the week to Thursday, while those of Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya and Zambia should be little changed, traders said.
n42ea605cc7.why: Currency moves in African frontier markets affect import costs, inflation and the dollar-denominated debt of local borrowers.

nbfc963430f.headline: Tyremaker Pirelli says revenue will be flat to slightly higher this year
nbfc963430f.summary: Pirelli expects 2026 revenue to remain flat or rise slightly, with projected earnings of €6.7 billion to €6.9 billion versus €6.78 billion last year. The company is an Italian tyre maker.
nbfc963430f.why: Pirelli is an Italian tyre manufacturer that supplies premium tyres to global automakers, so its outlook reflects demand in the auto and replacement tyre markets.

n64a837e518.headline: Kenya returns to international markets with $2.25B Dual-Tranche Eurobond
n64a837e518.summary: Kenya raised $2.25 billion through a dual-tranche Eurobond with 7.875% and 8.7% coupons. Proceeds include $500 million for buybacks of 2028 and 2032 notes and $1.75 billion for the budget.
n64a837e518.why: Eurobonds are dollar-denominated sovereign debt sold to international investors, and their pricing signals a country's borrowing costs and access to global capital.

nba95845f4f.headline: Qantas shares nosedive amid weak international demand
nba95845f4f.summary: Qantas shares rose in early trading but then faltered and plunged to a three-month low. The input cites weak international demand.
nba95845f4f.why: Qantas is Australia's largest airline and a bellwether for travel demand in the region. Share moves reflect expectations for its earnings.
nba95845f4f.why_moved: Qantas shares reversed early gains and dropped to a three-month low, with weak international demand cited as the backdrop.

nf6bb009748.headline: Japan says US tariff pressure on car sector easing
nf6bb009748.summary: Japan's Cabinet Office said in its February economic report that the impact of US tariffs on Japanese automakers is easing. The report cites improved exports to the US and a better auto production outlook.
nf6bb009748.why: Japan's auto sector is a major export industry, and US tariffs on vehicles directly affect its margins and shipments. Official economic reports shape views on the broader Japanese economy.

naa19d09f1d.headline: ASIC Watch: DDO Enforcement Hits Distribution Line
naa19d09f1d.summary: The Federal Court's penalty against Australian Unity Funds Management signals that DDO enforcement now targets distribution failures. Parallel enforcement includes jail terms for insider trading.
naa19d09f1d.why: ASIC is Australia's corporate and financial services regulator, and Design and Distribution Obligations set rules for how financial products are sold. Enforcement signals shape compliance costs across the sector.

n368c9c49ab.headline: Chevron deal sparks backlash over offshore drilling plans south of Crete and the Peloponnese
n368c9c49ab.summary: The Greek state signed an agreement with a Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY consortium granting exclusive rights to explore for hydrocarbons in sea areas south of Crete and the Peloponnese. The deal has drawn public backlash.
n368c9c49ab.why: Chevron is a major US oil company, and HELLENiQ ENERGY is Greece's largest refiner. Offshore exploration rights determine future domestic energy supply and investment.

nbef0511868.headline: Knesset lifts double social security burden for US immigrants
nbef0511868.summary: A new Israeli law grants American immigrants a five-year exemption from National Insurance payments on income already taxed by US Social Security. The change addresses a financial hurdle to aliyah.
nbef0511868.why: National Insurance and US Social Security are payroll-based systems, so double contributions raise costs for people moving between the two countries. Changes affect the economics of immigration and labour supply.

n4d27b8e9ea.headline: Renewables growth energises spending as inflation rises
n4d27b8e9ea.summary: Capital expenditure is rising fast in Australia, driven by renewables growth. The treasurer has warned that stubborn inflation will mean savings are needed.
n4d27b8e9ea.why: Capital expenditure shows how much businesses are investing, and it feeds into growth and inflation. Renewable energy investment is a major area of Australian corporate spending.

n7595c2b3ad.headline: India Inc. likely to sustain 8–10 pc revenue growth in Q4: Report
n7595c2b3ad.summary: A report says Indian companies are likely to sustain 8-10% year-on-year revenue growth in Q4 FY26. Operating margins could expand by 50-75 basis points on firm rural demand.
n7595c2b3ad.why: Quarterly corporate revenue and margin trends indicate the health of India's listed corporate sector. They also reflect domestic consumption and economic momentum.

nd6015ad3af.headline: Aramco’s Gas Strategy Builds Momentum with Major Progress Towards Growth Target
nd6015ad3af.summary: Aramco said it began production at Jafurah, the Middle East's largest unconventional gas field, and started operations at the Tanajib Gas Plant, one of the largest gas plants in the world.
nd6015ad3af.why: Saudi Aramco is the state-owned oil and gas producer of Saudi Arabia and one of the world's largest energy companies. Gas expansion affects its growth targets and domestic energy supply.

ne0a5e0ea02.headline: PM Modi, Netanyahu welcome India-Israel Financial Dialogue
ne0a5e0ea02.summary: Prime Ministers Modi and Netanyahu welcomed the India-Israel Financial Dialogue, and the first round of Free Trade Agreement talks concluded in Delhi.
ne0a5e0ea02.why: A free trade agreement would reduce tariffs and barriers on bilateral trade and investment between India and Israel, affecting exporters and investors in both countries.

n9c847ac480.headline: Rates for Mideast-Asia Oil Tanker at Highest Since 2020
n9c847ac480.summary: The cost of hiring a supertanker from the Middle East to China exceeded $200,000 a day for the first time since 2020, as the threat of U.S. action raised shipping risk.
n9c847ac480.why: Tanker freight rates reflect demand for crude shipments and perceived risk on key routes, and they feed into the delivered cost of oil.

n6edcb05699.headline: US stocks slip as Nvidia selloff weighs despite broad gains
n6edcb05699.summary: US stocks drifted lower on Thursday as a selloff in Nvidia weighed on the broader market, even as most shares posted gains. The S&P 500 fell 0.6 percent.
n6edcb05699.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of large US companies, and Nvidia is the largest AI chip maker whose share price has a large weight in market moves.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: A selloff in Nvidia's shares was the main drag on the index.

n6edcb05699.why_moved: A selloff in Nvidia weighed on the broader market, pulling the S&P 500 lower even though most individual shares rose.

n1683f95b1f.headline: Aussie shares reset records as earnings boon rolls on
n1683f95b1f.summary: The Australian sharemarket's value swelled by about $85 billion in February to record highs, swept up by earnings results.
n1683f95b1f.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index, so record highs reflect broad moves in the country's largest listed companies.
n1683f95b1f.why_moved: Earnings results lifted share prices across the market, adding about $85 billion in value in February.

n89ec8eb529.headline: FCC affirms authority to tax officials to conduct raids without prior notice in Pakistan
n89ec8eb529.summary: The FCC upheld the Super Tax last month, allowing the FBR to collect an estimated Rs150–200 billion in the January–March 2026 quarter, and affirmed authority for raids without prior notice.
n89ec8eb529.why: The Federal Board of Revenue is Pakistan's tax authority, and its collections affect the government's fiscal position and the IMF-linked budget outlook.

nfb2d67777c.headline: Billions lost as expired, smuggled cigarettes hit Pakistan’s markets
nfb2d67777c.summary: Repacking of expired and smuggled cigarettes of international brands took place under incentives for companies in Export Processing Zones. The report says billions have been lost.
nfb2d67777c.why: Illicit tobacco trade erodes government tax revenue and legitimate manufacturers' sales, which is a concern for investors in the sector and for fiscal policy.

n887caca871.headline: ‘Secondary market for SGBs is no longer a tax haven’: CA flags important rule shift from April 1 - BusinessToday
n887caca871.summary: From April 2026, tax-free redemption of Sovereign Gold Bonds will apply only to investors who subscribed in the primary issue through the RBI and hold to maturity.
n887caca871.why: Sovereign Gold Bonds are government-issued securities linked to gold prices, and changes to their tax treatment affect how Indian households hold gold exposure.

nf83ed89b0a.headline: SECP to probe ‘artificial crash’ of 20,000 points at PSX by brokers
nf83ed89b0a.summary: Pakistan's Securities and Exchange Commission has reportedly decided to investigate a sharp downturn of 20,000 points at the Pakistan Stock Exchange, which it has described as an artificial crash by brokers.
nf83ed89b0a.why: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan regulates the country's capital markets, and its enforcement actions shape investor confidence in the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n2e12fe03d7.headline: NSE IPO: Leading exchange invites banker to lead $2.5 billion offering, reports  - BusinessToday
n2e12fe03d7.summary: India's National Stock Exchange has issued a request for proposals to investment banks as it moves toward its long-awaited initial public offering. The $2.5 billion offering was reported by Bloomberg citing sources.
n2e12fe03d7.why: The National Stock Exchange of India is one of the world's largest exchanges by trading volume, so its listing would be a major event for India's capital markets.

nd99f2c2011.headline: Ruoming Pang, Meta’s $200M Superintelligence Hire, Jumps to OpenAI After Just 7 Months
nd99f2c2011.summary: Ruoming Pang, hired by Meta for its superintelligence lab, is leaving for OpenAI after just seven months. The move is a setback for Meta's superintelligence push, according to the report.
nd99f2c2011.why: Meta is developing advanced AI models, and talent moves among leading AI labs affect competitive positioning in the sector.

n5b0d3994b6.headline: AAV declares THB302.7 million core profit in 2025
n5b0d3994b6.summary: Asia Aviation, majority shareholder of Thai AirAsia, reported 2025 revenue of THB45.7 billion, down 8%. The decline reflected a 9% drop in average fares amid challenged tourism.
n5b0d3994b6.why: Asia Aviation controls Thai AirAsia, a low-cost carrier whose fares and passenger demand reflect regional travel and tourism trends.

n4c62aedca9.headline: Overseas companies repatriate nearly $1.7 billion from Pakistan amid decline in FDI
n4c62aedca9.summary: Foreign companies operating in Pakistan repatriated $1.68 billion in profits and dividends during the first seven months, amid a decline in foreign direct investment.
n4c62aedca9.why: Profit repatriation drains foreign currency reserves and signals how foreign investors view returns and conditions in Pakistan.

n08da7a83c8.headline: Gold ends six-day gaining streak in Pakistan; Check new prices
n08da7a83c8.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan declined on Thursday, ending a six-day gaining streak, amid a downward trend in the international market.
n08da7a83c8.why: Gold is a widely held store of value, and local prices in importing markets track international bullion prices and the local currency.

nebafdf4495.headline: Toyota plans R300bn share sale
nebafdf4495.summary: Toyota plans a large-scale unwinding of strategic shareholdings in which banks and insurance firms would sell around $19bn of its shares, two sources said.
nebafdf4495.why: Toyota is Japan's largest automaker, and unwinding cross-shareholdings is a major part of Japan's corporate governance reform affecting share supply.
nebafdf4495.why_moved: Reported plans for banks and insurers to sell about $19bn of Toyota shares add significant supply to the stock.

n87c11fa63e.headline: Megaworld profit hits all-time high in 2025
n87c11fa63e.summary: Philippine property developer Megaworld Corp. reported record earnings for 2025, driven by sustained growth across its core businesses.
n87c11fa63e.why: Megaworld is a major Philippine property developer with mixed-use townships, offices and malls, so its results signal the health of the domestic real estate sector.

n03dda664f2.headline: GCash warns public vs pre-sale of IPO shares
n03dda664f2.summary: E-wallet firm GCash warned the public against dealing with people claiming early access to shares in its upcoming initial public offering.
n03dda664f2.why: GCash is the Philippines' leading e-wallet, owned by Mynt, and its planned IPO would be one of the country's most closely watched listings.

n797054ec80.headline: Village cooperatives to support street vendors, MSMEs: Minister
n797054ec80.summary: Indonesia's cooperatives minister said the Red and White Village Cooperatives program would support street vendors and micro, small and medium enterprises.
n797054ec80.why: Micro, small and medium enterprises employ most of Indonesia's workforce, so government support programs for them shape domestic consumption and growth.

nd6b7e1e8b1.headline: Austral Gold Limited: Austral Gold Files Appendix 4E Preliminary Final 2025 Report
nd6b7e1e8b1.summary: Austral Gold Limited, an established gold producer, filed its Appendix 4E Preliminary Final 2025 Report.
nd6b7e1e8b1.why: Austral Gold is a mining company; financial reports provide insight into operational and financial health affecting investor decisions.
